title: 'Seibetsu "Mona Lisa" no Kimi e.' Reveals Main Cast, Staff, Teaser Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Tsumuji Yoshimura 's Seibetsu "Mona Lisa" no Kimi e. ( Just Like Mona Lisa ) manga revealed the main cast, staff, and a teaser promotional video on Saturday. Voice actress Chika Anzai ( Grand Blue ) is starring as the main character Hinase Arima.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Just Like Mona Lisa Anime by Studio SHAFT Reveals First Trailer, Main Staff and Cast
content: The anime adaptation of Tsumuji Yoshimura’s Just Like Mona Lisa ( Seibetsu “Mona Lisa” no Kimi e ) revealed the first trailer, along with the main staff and cast. As previously confirmed , studio SHAFT is in charge of the animation production.
author: Anime Corner

title: FX Fighter KURUMICHAN Anime Reveals Key Visual, Trailer, Additional Cast, October 2026 Premiere, Ending Song
content: The previously announced FX Fighter KURUMICHAN anime revealed a key visual and a new trailer, along with three additional cast members, an October 2026 premiere date, and the ending theme song. Four character visuals were also unveiled. Studio Passione is animating the series.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'FX Senshi Kurumi-chan' Reveals Additional Cast, Ending Theme for Fall 2026
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Demunyan and Daisuki Tansan 's FX Senshi Kurumi-chan ( FX Fighter Kurumi-chan ) manga revealed additional cast, a key visual (pictured), and the ending theme on Saturday. The anime series will premiere in October 2026.
author: MyAnimeList

title: MAPPA Reveals New Jujutsu Kaisen, Chainsaw Man, and Attack on Titan Illustrations Ahead of 15th Anniversary Expo
content: MAPPA revealed a series of newly drawn illustrations for several of its biggest anime franchises as part of the upcoming MAPPA EXPO 15th Anniversary exhibition. The artwork will be featured at the exhibition alongside exclusive merchandise, with advance lottery ticket sales for the event currently underway.
author: Anime Corner

title: 3 Action-Packed 2026 Anime Every Solo Leveling Fan Should Watch
content: It has been over a year since the action-packed second season of Solo Leveling came to an end. The anime’s action was executed perfectly in the final moments of the season, delivering a level of animation and spectacle rarely seen in other series.
author: ComicBook

title: Digimon Brand-New TV Anime Announced for 2027
content: Following the launch of its 30th anniversary project, the Digimon franchise has confirmed that a brand-new TV anime is officially in production and scheduled to premiere in 2027.
author: Anime Corner

title: Honey Parade Games Reveals Title, Video for New Senran Kagura Smartphone, PC Game
content: Marvelous and Honey∞Parade Games revealed on Friday the title and a video for their previously announced new smartphone game in the Senran Kagura franchise. The game is titled Shinobi Nexus: Senran Kagura . The game will launch for iOS and Android and for PC via DMM Games this year.
author: ANN

title: FuRyu Releases Trailers, Demos for Crymelight, Anomalith Games
content: FuRyu revealed new trailers on Saturday for both its CRYMELIGHT game and ANOMALITH game . FuRyu also released limited-time playable demos for both games on Steam . The demos are available from July 31 at 12:00 p.m. EDT through August 9 at 10:59 a.m. EDT to coincide with the "Six One Demo Days" Steam event.
author: ANN
